subject: Alliance account ownership arbitration — Nexus Analytics / eMerge integration
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Nexus Analytics <partners@nexus-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + potential integration / co-sell with eMerge

Hi Rohit / Nexus team,

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap: Nexus is exploring a plug-in that forwards streaming telemetry into Redwood for inference enrichment; eMerge (your systems integrator) would like joint GTM. Before we schedule an architecture review, can you confirm which enterprise accounts you want included in the initial pilot and whether any are under an existing alliance with eMerge? That will help us avoid territory overlap.

Next steps: if you can share a short list of target accounts and the proposed pilot scope (1-2 pages), we can draft a mutual action plan.

Attaching a brief template for the MAP so we’re aligned.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_CoSell_Guidelines.pdf (stub)

From: Rohit Mehra <rohit@emerge.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Nexus Analytics <partners@nexus-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + potential integration / co-sell with eMerge

Priya — thanks for the template and the quick sync. Attaching the pilot account list (3 targets) and a one-page summary. Important note: eMerge currently owns the primary contact relationship at two of those accounts (Easton Health and Meridian Retail). We flagged Easton last quarter for platform integration work. eMerge has asked to retain lead for Easton; Nexus thinks the solution fit is better with Redwood driving the technical engagement.

Would appreciate if Redwood can propose a conflict-resolution path — ideally with a neutral prioritization criteria (existing SOW, renewal window, ARR coverage).

Regards,
Rohit
Partnerships, eMerge AI
rohit@emerge.ai

Attachment: Nexus_MAPlan_v2.xlsx (stub)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alliance account ownership arbitration — Nexus / eMerge (internal)

Team — forwarding Nexus' ask. Quick read:
- Accounts: Easton Health (eMerge claims lead), Meridian Retail (eMerge claims lead), Vela Insurance (Nexus primary)
- Risk: eMerge expects to lead Easton; Nexus wants Redwood to drive technical proof-of-concept there.

Proposal: apply our partner arbitration rubric: (1) existing signed SOW or active paid engagement in last 12 months, (2) renewal/negotiation window within 90 days, (3) strategic overlap (co-sell commitment). If no clear winner, we split GTM: eMerge handles account team introductions and contract negotiation; Redwood handles technical PoC and product implementation during pilot, with clear credit assignment in the MAP.

Can Laura/Marissa vet whether Easton has any active SOWs with eMerge on file? Sergio — want you on the thread to review potential co-sell credit (commission impact) and any marketplace listing requirements. Monica — please prepare a quick slide for the partner council if we need a formal escalation.

Short replies appreciated — Nexus asked for a resolution by EOB Friday.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alliance account ownership arbitration — Nexus / eMerge (internal)

Jonas — checked contracts. eMerge has a signed SOW for Easton Health dated 2025-11-03 for integration work (non-Redwood). However, that SOW is for data ingestion and dashboarding; it does not explicitly cover inference or model hosting. No active SOW for Meridian Retail. Vela Insurance is clear Nexus territory.

Given that, I support the split-GTM approach for Easton: give eMerge lead on commercial and introductions; Redwood owns the PoC and technical implementation work in pilot with a predefined handoff for scale. We'll ask for explicit language in the MAP that defines crediting and next-phase ownership.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Nexus Analytics <partners@nexus-analytics.com>, Rohit Mehra <rohit@emerge.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner arbitration proposal + MAP draft

Rohit / Nexus — thanks for the transparency. After internal review we propose the following arbitration outcome for pilot accounts:

1) Easton Health: eMerge retains commercial lead and contract ownership for the pilot (they provided the original SOW). Redwood will own the technical PoC and deliver model integration; MAP will include clear acceptance criteria and a transition plan to determine scale ownership at pilot end.
2) Meridian Retail: no active eMerge SOW; Nexus will own the account introduction and Redwood will co-sell jointly.
3) Vela Insurance: Nexus owns lead and Redwood provides technical integration.

Attached is a one-page MAP with fields for credit assignment, acceptance criteria, and a 60-day pilot timeline. Please review and confirm by COB Aug 21. Once we have alignment we will schedule a technical kickoff.

Best,
Priya

Attachment: partner_claim_map.pdf (stub)

From: Rohit Mehra <rohit@emerge.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Nexus Analytics <partners@nexus-analytics.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner arbitration proposal + MAP draft

Priya / Jonas / team — thanks, that split approach is fair and workable from eMerge's perspective. We'll sign the MAP with the Easton clause and confirm the pilot contacts by EOD Monday. One ask: can Redwood include a clause that gives eMerge preferred consideration for the first 6 months of any paid implementation beyond pilot, assuming Easton signs? That would be consistent with our investment in the SOW.

If you can add that clause to the MAP, we can sign and move to kickoff.

Rohit
Rohit Mehra
VP Partnerships, eMerge AI
rohit@emerge.ai
